apitokens.all.empty: Nobody has an API token yet.
apitokens.all.heading: All tokens
apitokens.all.hint: Every user's tokens. Admins see them all and can revoke any of them.
apitokens.api.forced: REST API access is forced off by the server's configuration, so it cannot be changed here.
apitokens.api.heading: REST API access
apitokens.api.state.forced: REST API access is off because Foreman was started with {env}. It cannot be turned on here.
apitokens.api.state.off: REST API access is off. Every request to the REST API is refused, whatever its token.
apitokens.api.state.on: REST API access is on. Programs with a valid API token can use Foreman.
apitokens.banner.expired: Your API token {name} expired at {time} and is refused until you renew it.
apitokens.banner.heading: API tokens that need renewing
apitokens.both_off: MCP and REST API access are both off, so this token will not work until an admin turns one on.
apitokens.create.admin_warning: Before a destructive admin action, Foreman asks the program to confirm it a second time. That guards against mistakes, not against an AI steered by something it read, such as a player's chat message. Give admin scope only when you need it.
apitokens.create.heading: Create a token
apitokens.create.name: Name
apitokens.create.name.hint: Up to {max} letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores and hyphens. Chat sent through the token starts with it.
apitokens.create.name.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to {max} letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores or hyphens.
apitokens.create.name.taken: You already have a token with this name. Choose another name.
apitokens.create.scope.hint: Pick the smallest scope the program needs. The scope cannot be changed later.
apitokens.created.once: Copy the token now. Foreman stores only a hash of it and will never show it again. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
apitokens.created.title: Token {name} created
apitokens.done.renewed: Renewed {name}. It works for another 30 days.
apitokens.done.revoked: Revoked {name}. It can never be used again.
apitokens.intro: An API token lets a program, such as an AI assistant or a script, act as you through Foreman's MCP endpoint or its REST API. Each token works for 30 days after it is created or renewed.
apitokens.mcp.forced: MCP access is forced off by the server's configuration, so it cannot be changed here.
apitokens.mcp.heading: MCP access
apitokens.mcp.state.forced: MCP access is off because Foreman was started with {env}. It cannot be turned on here.
apitokens.mcp.state.off: MCP access is off. Every request to the MCP endpoint is refused, whatever its token.
apitokens.mcp.state.on: MCP access is on. Programs with a valid API token can use Foreman.
apitokens.mine.empty: You have no API tokens yet.
apitokens.mine.heading: Your tokens
apitokens.renew.name: Renew {name}
apitokens.renew.revoked: This token was revoked, so it can never be renewed. Create a new one instead.
apitokens.revoke.final: This is final: a revoked token can never be renewed.
apitokens.revoke.name: Revoke {name} of {owner}
apitokens.revoke.question: Revoke {name} of {owner}?
apitokens.revoke.stops: Every request that uses this token is refused from now on.
apitokens.scope.admin.hint: Also what an admin does in the UI, except users, API tokens and MCP access.
apitokens.scope.operate.hint: Also start, stop, restart, switch worlds, take snapshots and chat.
apitokens.scope.read.hint: See the server, worlds, players, log, snapshots and mods. Changes nothing.
apitokens.title: API tokens
